    CASE
        WHEN ft."typename" = 'Prepared Meal' THEN 'Prepared Meal'

SELECT DISTINCT h."name" AS "hotel_name",
       c."name" AS "city_name",
       CASE
           WHEN lf."feature" = 'swimming pool' THEN 'Swimming Pool'
           WHEN lf."feature" = 'hot tub' THEN 'Hot Tub'
       END AS "feature"
FROM "hotel" h
JOIN "city" c ON h."city_id" = c."id"
JOIN "roomtype" rt ON h."id" = rt."hotel_id"
JOIN "featureinroom" fir ON rt."id" = fir."roomtype_id"
JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON fir."leisurefeature_id" = lf."id"
WHERE (lf."feature" = 'swimming pool' OR lf."feature" = 'hot tub')
  AND c."name" = 'New York'
ORDER BY h."name", "feature";

JOIN leisurefeature lf ON fir."leisurefeature_id" = lf."id"
JOIN city c ON h."city_id" = c."id"
WHERE LOWER(lf."feature") IN ('swimming pool', 'hot tub')
  AND LOWER(c."name") = 'new york';

WITH internship_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "internshipid") AS total_internships
    FROM "internships_responsibilities"
),
responsibility_counts AS (
    SELECT
        r."responsibility",
        COUNT(DISTINCT ir."internshipid") AS internship_count
    FROM "responsibilities" r
    JOIN "internships_responsibilities" ir ON r."id" = ir."responsibilityid"
    GROUP BY r."responsibility"
)
SELECT "responsibility"
FROM responsibility_counts
WHERE internship_count = (SELECT total_internships FROM internship_count);

WITH hospital_role_counts AS (
    SELECT
        mr."roleid",
        mr."rolename",
        COUNT(DISTINCT hmr."hospitalid") AS hospital_count
    FROM
        "medicalroles" mr
    JOIN
        "hospitals_medical_roles" hmr ON mr."roleid" = hmr."roleid"
    GROUP BY
        mr."roleid", mr."rolename"
),
total_hospitals AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT "hospitalid") AS total
    FROM
        "hospitals"
)
SELECT
    hrc."rolename"
FROM
    hospital_role_counts hrc
CROSS JOIN
    total_hospitals th
WHERE
    hrc.hospital_count = th.total
ORDER BY
    hrc."rolename";

        f."functionid",
